title: 滿分巔峰專業字彙 (TOEIC 900+) - 第 2 單元 (401~678 字)
description: 高難度商業文法句型、進階同義詞辨析與專業管理術語。（分單元 2/2）

words.definitionZh: 原野鴨（一種常見的鴨子種類，通常用於描述自然環境或生態系統，在商務情境中可能出現在與生態旅遊、環境保護相關的討論中）

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: During the annual shareholders meeting, executive directors highlighted the fundamental importance of mallard.
examples.zh: 在年度股東大會上，執行董事們強調了【原野鴨】的根本重要性。

examples.en: The plant supervisor implemented strict operational guidelines to ensure consistent quality in mallard.
examples.zh: 廠房主管實施了嚴格的營運準則，以確保在【原野鴨】方面保持一致的高品質。

examples.en: Strategic investment in mallard has positioned our enterprise as a frontrunner in global market competition.
examples.zh: 在【原野鴨】上的策略性投資，使我司在全球市場競爭中躍居領先地位。

quizzes.stem: The regional director emphasized that corporate _____ remains our highest priority for the upcoming fiscal year.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 區域總監強調，企業【原野鴨】依然是我們下一會計年度的首要重點。
quizzes.strategy: 空格位於 corporate 之後作為名詞主詞/受詞，選入名詞 mallard 最切合商務方針。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 注意名詞單複數與可數/不可數之文法特徵。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「原野鴨」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。

quizzes.stem: Strict compliance with established _____ is mandatory for all personnel operating heavy machinery.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 切實遵守既定的【原野鴨】，對於所有操作重型機具之人員皆屬強制規定。

quizzes.examTrapTip: 注意介系詞後受詞之詞性要求與上下文語法結構。

quizzes.stem: In the business memorandum, the word 'mallard' is closest in meaning to which of the following?
quizzes.stemTranslation: 在該商務備忘錄中，單字「mallard」（【原野鴨】）的意思與下列何者最接近？
quizzes.strategy: 在商務語境中，mallard（原野鴨）之核心涵義與 mallard 最相近。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 多益同義字測驗考查商務上下文語境，需選擇最具替換性之選項。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】在商務語境中為最精確之同義詞替換。

To: All Department Staff
Subject: Important Operational Update

Please ensure that our division takes all necessary measures to _____ established corporate benchmarks across daily operations.
quizzes.stemTranslation:
📧【內部備忘錄】
收件人：全體部門同仁
主旨：重要營運更新

To: Global Procurement Partners
Subject: Partnership and Service Confirmation

We are delighted to confirm that our organization can _____ your upcoming business requirements on schedule.
quizzes.stemTranslation:

The executive board has approved comprehensive guidelines to _____ sustainable performance across all regional subsidiaries.
